repos_data.description: Kratos Multiphysics (A.K.A Kratos) is a framework for building parallel multi-disciplinary simulation software. Modularity, extensibility and HPC are the main objectives. Kratos has BSD license and is written in C++ with extensive Python interface.
MCP server connecting AI agents to ITASCA engines (PFC, FLAC, 3DEC, MPoint, MassFlow) — run geotechnical & geomechanics simulations through natural conversation
MCP server connecting AI agents to YADE — run DEM simulations through natural conversation
